JUDGMENT :
 Heard learned counsel for the applicant.
2. The applicant has preferred the present
Application, under Section 11(6) of the Arbitration and
Conciliation Act, 1996, to seek an appointm ent of the
sole Arbitrator.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would
subm it that the parties had entered into an agreem ent
contained in the Super Distributor Agreem ent dated
25.12.2014, which contains an Agreem ent Clause. He
would take this Court through the Arbitration Clause of
the Agreem ent, which reads as under: -

2025:UHC:535
2
"I f any dispute arises between the parties at
any tim e in connection with the validity,
interpretation, im plem entation or alleged
m aterial breach of any provision of this
agreem ent, the parties shall endeavor to
settle such dispute am icably.
I n case of failure, the dispute shall be
referred to a sole arbitrator in accordance
with the provisions of The Arbitration and
Conciliation Act, 1996.
The venue for the arbitration proceeding shall
be Haridwar, Uttarakhand, I ndia, and the
language of arbitration shall be English.
The arbitrator(s) award shall be
substantiated in writing. The court of
arbitration shall also decide on the costs of
the arbitration proceedings.
The award passed by the Arbitrator(s) shall
be final and binding on both the parties."
4. The applicant invoked the arbitration
agreem ent, since disputes arose between the parties,
on 25.08.2023. However, no Arbitrator was mutually
appointed and, consequently, this Application has been
preferred.
5. Learned counsel for the respondents has put
in appearance and has also filed a counter-affidavit.
However, he has not disputed the fact about existence
of an arbitration clause in the Agreem ent.

2025:UHC:535
3
6. Today, learned counsel for the parties jointly
state that they seek appointm ent of Sri Ram Singh,
retired District Judge, R/ o Pleasant Valley, Near Sai
Baba Mandir, Old Mussoorie Road, Dehradun, as a sole
Arbitrator.
7. I n that view, the instant Application is
allowed.
8. Sri Ram Singh, retired District Judge, R/ o
Pleasant Valley, Near Sai Baba Mandir, Old Mussoorie
Road, Dehradun is appointed to officiate as an
Arbitrator to adjudicate the disputes that have arisen
between the parties on m erits, in accordance with the
Act.
9. Let a copy of this order be com m unicated to
Sri Ram Singh, retired District Judge.
10. There shall be no order as to costs.
11. I n sequel thereto, all pending Applications
stand disposed of.
